Custom Gallery Website $7,500

You can get a custom gallery site for $7,500. You own the code, content, and domain when it launches.

How it works

  1. Request a free homepage remake to see the design style.
  2. Approve the concept and pay a 50 % deposit.
  3. We build the full gallery site with unlimited sections, photo galleries, spreadsheet‑driven events, and email/form integrations.
  4. You review the live site, give final feedback, and the balance is charged at launch.
  5. The site goes live on Cloudflare Pages (hosting $0/month) and you keep full ownership.

What you get for $7,500

  • Unlimited sections and photo galleries (the US250 Tour case used 2,100+ photos).
  • Admin panel for easy content updates.
  • Spreadsheet‑based event management.
  • Email and form integrations.
  • Basic SEO and contact forms.
  • 90 days of free care after launch.
  • Optional care plans after the free period: $295 / month or $595 / month, cancel anytime.
  • No monthly hosting fee—$0/month on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub.

Why choose us

  • Remote‑first studio serving businesses, nonprofits, founders, and individuals.
  • Quick reply within one business day.
  • All work is done on a platform you control; there are no hidden fees.

FAQ

What does “custom” include? A unique design built for your brand, unlimited gallery sections, an admin panel, and any email or form integrations you need.

Do I own the website after launch? Yes. You own the code, the content, and the domain outright.

Can I add ongoing support later? After the 90‑day free care period you can choose a care plan for $295 / month or $595 / month, and you can cancel at any time.

Next step

Request the free homepage remake to start your custom gallery website project. /custom-website-launch-package/
